title: RSD-Poker: Structure-Adaptive and Shift-Robust Risk-Utility Certification for Residual Policies in Imperfect-Information Games
abstract: arXiv:2609.33669v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Residual policy adaptation provides a lightweight way to modify a strong reference policy, but a shared scale and a fixed subgroup partition can hide heterogeneous degradation and become fragile when the deployment mixture of information states changes. We introduce RSD-Poker, a structure-adaptive and shift-robust certification framework that freezes a bank of residual families and scales, learns a policy-visible partition on an independent structure split, and freezes that partition before calibration labels are joined. Each candidate-group pair receives a weighted simultaneous upper certificate for anchor-relative risk and a lower certificate for weak-response utility. A robust group-to-candidate map is then selected over a predeclared uncertainty set of deployment group proportions. translated_title: RSD-Poker：面向不完美信息游戏中残差策略的结构自适应与偏移稳健的风险-效用认证
translated_abstract: 残差策略适配提供了一种轻量级的方式来修改强参考策略，但共享的缩放尺度与固定的子群划分可能掩盖异质性的性能退化，并在部署时信息状态混合分布发生变化时变得脆弱。我们提出了 RSD-Poker，一个结构自适应且对分布偏移稳健的认证框架：它冻结一个由残差族和尺度组成的候选库，在独立的结构划分集上学习一个策略可见的子群划分，并在加入校准标签之前冻结该划分。每个“候选-组”配对都会获得一个关于相对于锚点策略风险的加权同时上界证书，以及一个关于弱响应效用的下界证书。随后，在一个预先声明的部署组比例不确定性集合上，选出稳健的组到候选的映射。在从每个冻结组的分布中抽取独立校准单元、候选库与划分在校准前固定、以及组内……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 RSD-Poker 框架，通过冻结残差候选库、学习并预先冻结策略可见的子群划分，为不完美信息游戏中的残差策略提供对部署分布偏移稳健的风险上界与效用下界双证书认证。
en_tdlr: RSD-Poker delivers structure-adaptive, shift-robust certification for residual policies in imperfect-information games by freezing a residual candidate bank and a learned policy-visible partition before calibration, issuing simultaneous upper bounds on anchor-relative risk and lower bounds on weak-response utility, and selecting a robust group-to-candidate map over a predeclared uncertainty set of deployment group proportions.
